# Claude usage fixtures

No verified Claude v2 usage response has been captured in this workspace as of 2026-08-20.
The usage and Extra endpoints are undocumented, so no payload fixture is checked in and no
source keys are guessed. Production reports both sections as `feature-unavailable` until a
redacted response is captured with its endpoint path, status, observed field names, and feature
set. Authorization, cookies, request IDs, account IDs, and raw headers must be omitted from any
future fixture.
